decision: Is the JSON-LD on this page valid, true to what the page shows, and complete for its type?
limitations: It only compares markup with what readers see when you pass html or visibleText. Without them, a rating or price the page doesn't show can still pass as Ready to publish.
It checks the markup you paste, not what a crawler receives. JSON-LD added by client-side JavaScript may never reach a crawler.
A clean check does not promise a rich result or any effect on AI answers. Google says no special schema is needed for its AI features.
Its rules follow Google and schema.org pages opened on 2026-10-10. Google edits those pages; re-check the source each finding cites.
review: Whoever owns the site confirms every price, rating, question and date in the markup appears on the live page, then re-validates the deployed URL with Google's Rich Results Test and checks the JSON-LD is in the server response.
